problem: All three authored rectangular aperture frames were manifold at base, but their blanket Bevel modifiers each produced 64 evaluated non-manifold edges around inner/outer loops.
decision: Preserve the failed detailed candidate, retain the connected all-quad frame meshes, and remove the unsafe frame bevels rather than weakening evaluated-geometry gates.
visual_note: The overall detailed design was visually promising; rejection is scoped to evaluated frame topology.
